headline: ACT Capital Advisors Launches Broker-Dealer Affiliate for Capital Raising
summary: ACT Capital Advisors has launched a new broker-dealer affiliate, ACT Capital Markets, to provide capital-raising and financing services. The expansion moves the firm beyond its traditional M&A advisory focus.
why: Broker-dealer affiliates allow advisory firms to offer a broader range of financial services, including underwriting and private placements, which can diversify revenue streams.
